title: INC-1042 Payment API report
content: INC-1042 incident report. Payment API. Opened 2026-04-14T09:17:00Z. Impact began 2026-04-14T09:12:00Z: checkout requests returned HTTP 503 and p95 latency rose to 8.4 seconds. Preliminary hypothesis H1 was a network partition between the API and PostgreSQL. Conflicting preliminary hypothesis H2 was a sudden card processor slowdown. Neither hypothesis was confirmed. Investigators compared application logs, service metrics, configuration changes, and independent checks. Confirmed root cause at 2026-04-14T10:06:00Z: a deployment changed the PostgreSQL connection pool maximum from 80 to 20 per pod while six pods held long transactions; all available connections were exhausted. Supporting evidence: pg_stat_activity showed 120 active connections and 340 waiters; payment-api pool_acquire_timeout rose to 42 percent. Remediation: rolled back the pool setting to 80, terminated orphaned long transactions, and added pool saturation alerts. Resolved 2026-04-14T10:06:00Z. Evidence source IDs: INC-1042-LOGS, INC-1042-RUNBOOK, INC-1042-POSTMORTEM. This report source ID is INC-1042-REPORT.
